rig_001: You can recognise it by the rowan growing out of the fork where its trunk divides. It stands on Lucavsala island, near the monument to the fallen Russian soldiers.
rig_002: You can recognise it by the metal sheets and plates patching its trunk, and props supporting it. It stands in the park of the former Ēbeļmuiža manor, in Ziepniekkalns.
rig_003: You can recognise it by the sealed hollow in its trunk, scarred from old fires. It stands beside Mašēnu Lake, next to the Ezerkrasti care centre.
rig_004: You can recognise it by its trunk, forking into two stems about two and a half metres up. It stands beside a wooden tenement house in the Kalnciema Quarter.
rig_005: You can recognise it as the oak growing in the canal-side park, a few minutes' walk from the Freedom Monument and the Laima Clock. It stands in the Kanālmalas apstādījumi.
